quantize_model_scalar: quantize a fairseq model in place using scalar quantization noise with 8-bit precision
create_Quantizer: create a Quantizer instance from a YAML config file with epoch or update based scheduling
step_quantizer: step the Quantizer to the next quantization stage and reinitialize the trainer
begin_epoch_quantizer: begin an epoch and trigger quantization step if the epoch schedule aligns
load_state_dict_quantizer: load a Quantizer state dict to restore quantization progress from a checkpoint
